settings.editor: If your system is struggling, we have the tools to diagnose and repair it immediately. We frequently handle:

settings.description_text: Faulty compressors or refrigerant leaks can turn your AC into a glorified fan. We pinpoint the leak and restore cooling levels fast.
Squealing, grinding, or banging sounds often signal a failing motor or loose belt. We fix it before it becomes a total system failure.
If your AC turns on and off constantly, it’s killing your energy efficiency. We calibrate your system to run in perfect cycles.
Usually caused by restricted airflow or low refrigerant. We clear the blockage and get the air moving again.
Systems that fail to pull moisture from the air properly leave your home feeling "muggy."

settings.title: What to Expect During Your Visit

settings.editor:
When a Petitt technician arrives, we perform a complete system diagnostic. We check your thermostat calibration, inspect electrical components (like capacitors and contactors), and verify refrigerant levels. You will receive a full explanation of the issue and a firm quote before any repairs begin. 

Found your symptom? Don't wait for the unit to die completely.
